purpose: Shop data: which avatar parts are free and what the others cost in points.
details: Loaded by kern/winkel.py (BESTAND). 'gratis' lists the parts every child has from the start (square shape, blue, plain eyes, round ears and no ears); 'prijzen' maps layer -> part id -> price in points. The catalogue in kern/winkel.catalogus is built from this file plus the part names in onderdelen.json. Part ids must match onderdelen.json.

field_notes.explanation: Short note: prices in points, 'gratis' = every child has them at once.
Per layer the free part ids.
Per layer (vorm, kleur, ogen, oren, haar, hoed, accessoire) the price of each part.
